# Asteroid Escape

Control a ship with the arrow keys (left/right to rotate, up to thrust). Asteroids spawn from random edges and drift across the canvas. The objective is to survive as long as possible. **Lose condition:** the ship collides with an asteroid or leaves the canvas bounds.

1: // Asteroid Escape game implementation targeting <canvas id="game">
2: (() => {
3:   // Create starfield background
4:   const starCount = 100;
5:   const stars = [];
6:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
7:     stars.push({
8:       x: Math.random() * width,
9:       y: Math.random() * height,
10:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
11:     });
12:   }
13:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
14:   if (!canvas) return;
15:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
16:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth);
17:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight);
18: 
19:   // Ship state
20:   const ship = {
21:     x: width / 2,
22:     y: height / 2,
23:     vx: 0,
24:     vy: 0,
25:     angle: 0,
26:     radius: 10,
27:     rotating: 0, // -1 left, 1 right, 0 none
28:     thrusting: false,
29:   };
30: 
31:   const asteroids = [];
32:   const maxAsteroids = 5;
33:   const asteroidMinSize = 15;
34:   const asteroidMaxSize = 30;
35: 
36:   const keys = {};
37:   // Audio setup
38:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
39:   let thrustOsc = null;
40:   function startThrustSound() {
41:     if (thrustOsc) return;
42:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
43:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
44:     thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime);
45:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
46:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
47:     thrustOsc.start();
48:   }
49:   function stopThrustSound() {
50:     if (!thrustOsc) return;
51:     thrustOsc.stop();
52:     thrustOsc.disconnect();
53:     thrustOsc = null;
54:   }
55:   function playExplosionSound() {
56:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
57:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
58:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(150, audioCtx.currentTime);
59:     osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(30, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
60:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
61:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
62:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
63:     osc.start();
64:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
65:   }
66: 
67:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
68:     keys[e.key] = true;
69:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.rotating = -1;
70:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.rotating = 1;
71:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
72:       ship.thrusting = true;
73:       startThrustSound();
74:     }
75:   });
76:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
77:     keys[e.key] = false;
78:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && ship.rotating === -1) ship.rotating = 0;
79:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && ship.rotating === 1) ship.rotating = 0;
80:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
81:       ship.thrusting = false;
82:       stopThrustSound();
83:     }
84:   });
85: 
86:   function spawnAsteroid() {
87:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
88:     let x, y, vx, vy;
89:     const size = Math.random() * (asteroidMaxSize - asteroidMinSize) + asteroidMinSize;
90:     switch (side) {
91:       case 0: // top
92:         x = Math.random() * width;
93:         y = -size;
94:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
95:         vy = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
96:         break;
97:       case 1: // right
98:         x = width + size;
99:         y = Math.random() * height;
100:         vx = -Math.random() * 1.5 - 0.5;
101:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
102:         break;
103:       case 2: // bottom
104:         x = Math.random() * width;
105:         y = height + size;
106:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
107:         vy = -Math.random() * 1.5 - 0.5;
108:         break;
109:       case 3: // left
110:         x = -size;
111:         y = Math.random() * height;
112:         vx = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
113:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
114:         break;
115:     }
116:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
117:   }
118: 
119:   function update(dt) {
120:     // Ship rotation
121:     if (ship.rotating) ship.angle += ship.rotating * 0.05 * dt;
122:     // Thrust
123:     if (ship.thrusting) {
124:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * 0.1 * dt;
125:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * 0.1 * dt;
126:     }
127:     // Friction
128:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
129:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
130:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
131:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
132: 
133:     // Keep ship inside bounds (lose if leaves)
134:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) {
135:       gameOver();
136:     }
137: 
138:     // Asteroids movement
139:     for (const a of asteroids) {
140:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
141:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
142:     }
143:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
144:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
145:       const a = asteroids[i];
146:       if (a.x < -a.radius || a.x > width + a.radius || a.y < -a.radius || a.y > height + a.radius) {
147:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
148:       }
149:     }
150:     // Collision detection
151:     for (const a of asteroids) {
152:       const dx = ship.x - a.x;
153:       const dy = ship.y - a.y;
154:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
155:       if (dist < ship.radius + a.radius) {
156:         gameOver();
157:         break;
158:       }
159:     }
160:     // Spawn new asteroids
161:     if (asteroids.length < maxAsteroids && Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
162:   }
163: 
164:   function draw() {
165:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
166:     // Starfield background
167:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
168:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
169:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
170:     for (const s of stars) {
171:       ctx.beginPath();
172:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
173:       ctx.fill();
174:     }
175:     // Ship (triangle with outline)
176:     ctx.save();
177:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
178:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
179:     ctx.beginPath();
180:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
181:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
182:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
183:     ctx.closePath();
184:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
185:     ctx.fill();
186:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'cyan';
187:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
188:     ctx.stroke();
189:     // Thrust flame
190:     if (ship.thrusting) {
191:       ctx.beginPath();
192:       ctx.moveTo(-10, -5);
193:       ctx.lineTo(-18, 0);
194:       ctx.lineTo(-10, 5);
195:       ctx.closePath();
196:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
197:       ctx.fill();
198:     }
199:     ctx.restore();
200:     // Asteroids (irregular with gradient)
201:     for (const a of asteroids) {
202:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
203:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
204:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
205:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
206:       ctx.beginPath();
207:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
208:       ctx.fill();
209:     }
210:   }
211: 
212:   let last = performance.now();
213:   let over = false;
214:   function loop(now) {
215:     const dt = (now - last) / 16; // normalized to ~60fps steps
216:     last = now;
217:     if (!over) {
218:       update(dt);
219:       draw();
220:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
221:     }
222:   }
223:   function gameOver() {
224:     over = true;
225:     // Play explosion sound
226:     playExplosionSound();
227:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
228:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
229:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
230:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
231:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
232:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
233:   }
234: 
235:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
236: })();

(End of file - total 236 lines)
</content>
